name: Seated band row
summary: Horizontal pull with a band looped around the feet or anchored in a door.
steps: Sit with legs straight and loop the band around the soles of the feet.
Sit tall, arms straight in front, slight tension on the band.
Pull the hands to the lower ribs, elbows close to the body, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Return slowly until the arms are straight.
commonMistakes: Leaning far back to move the band.
breathing: Exhale while pulling, inhale while returning.
harder: Stronger or doubled band, more pre-tension, 1-2 s squeeze.
contraindications: Lower back pain when sitting: sit on a cushion or use a door anchor while standing.

start.alt: Seated, legs straight, arms reaching forward holding a band looped around the feet.

end.alt: Seated upright, hands pulled to the ribs, elbows behind the body.
